verdict.rationale: Context.dev's evidence describes a fixed set of hosted API endpoints (scrape, crawl, extract-with-schema, screenshot, browser actions, monitor) that developers call via SDK/CLI/MCP — this is serverless in the sense of no infra to manage, but there is no evidence of a capability to write and deploy arbitrary custom scraping scripts/code on the platform (no actors, functions, or custom-code deployment feature is documented).
